changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Separate technical structure-harvest state from the governed business lifecycle. Legacy SYNCED and STALE lifecycle values are preserved in harvest_status, while an exact-row backup keeps rollback from rewriting rows created or edited later.

rollback.sql:
UPDATE catalog_asset_extension extension_row SET lifecycle_status = backup.previous_lifecycle_status FROM catalog_harvest_status_migration_backup backup WHERE backup.entity_type = 'CATALOG_ASSET_EXTENSION' AND backup.entity_id = extension_row.id;
UPDATE catalog_dataset dataset_row SET lifecycle_status = backup.previous_lifecycle_status FROM catalog_harvest_status_migration_backup backup WHERE backup.entity_type = 'CATALOG_DATASET' AND backup.entity_id = dataset_row.id;
